bug_semantics: OliveTin ACL defines view permission (acl.IsAllowedView) separately from exec. After the 3k API rewrite, dashboard and action-metadata responses stopped enforcing view. At the pre-fix tree, buildDefaultDashboard (service/internal/api/dashboards.go:120-146) iterated executor.MapActionBindings, skipped only Hidden/IsOnDashboard, then called buildAction which sets CanExec from IsAllowedExec only (apiActions.go:120-123). GetActionBinding (api.go:430-449) returned that Action protobuf after a guest-login check with no per-action view check; findActionForEntity did the same for custom dashboards. Authenticated users with view:false could therefore enumerate action titles, IDs, icons, descriptions, and argument metadata via POST /api/GetDashboard and POST /api/GetActionBinding while canExec stayed false.
flaw_origin: The pre-3k dashboard builder already had the required control: at parent d4fe9eaa, buildDashboardResponse in service/internal/grpcapi/grpcApiActions.go:28 skipped actions unless acl.IsAllowedView matched. BIC a62d58f11955fe192f45da13e23ba996a2759404 (chore: OliveTin 3k progress) renamed that file to service/internal/api/apiActions.go, deleted the IsAllowedView filter, left AllowedActionTitles unpopulated, and first-wrote buildDefaultDashboard in the renamed dashboards.go to emit every non-hidden binding. Parent tree has no buildDefaultDashboard and still uses IsAllowedView for dashboard action lists. Later 6b342cbedb041f515a76495cec69f9979bd34d1e attached the Action payload to dashboard components and introduced GetActionBinding without a view check; those are additional sinks on the same missing-check, not the first write. Subsequent MapActionIdToBinding→MapActionBindings/IsOnDashboard edits are refactors of a62d58f's loop.
